# MftSeedWorkflow.Contracts.ps1

Supplies the public PowerShell functions shared by the MFT seed creator and full benchmark runner: `Get-MftSeedWorkflowHostInventory`, `Get-MftSeedWorkflowPlan`, `Assert-MftWorkflowDirectory`, `Assert-MftWorkflowNoReparsePath`, `Assert-MftWorkflowHostVolume`, `Assert-MftWorkflowProtectedVolume`, `Assert-MftWorkflowOutsideRepository`, `Assert-MftExternalArtifactRoot`, `Get-MftWorkflowAvailableDriveLetter`, `Assert-MftWorkflowNewRawDisk`, `Assert-MftWorkflowPlanStorageRoots`, `Assert-MftWorkflowMountedSeedIdentity`, `Test-MftWorkflowAdministrator`, `New-MftSeedEvidenceRun`, `New-MftDirectoryCreateNew`, `New-MftVhdxCreateNew`, `Write-MftCreateNewJson`, `Get-MftSha256`, `ConvertTo-MftProcessArgumentLine`, and `Get-MftWindowsFileIdentity`.

Invariants: approved/evidence roots already exist, are local fixed NTFS directories, are not volume roots, repository/OneDrive/Documents paths, known synchronized or reparse/recall paths, and are not system/boot/recovery/pagefile/crash-dump volumes. Seed plans use a new GUID path and require 60 GiB free. Mutating stages recheck path, VHDX/file identity, disk/partition/volume IDs and protected roles. JSON writes use `FileMode.CreateNew`; this module never removes or rolls back output. External artifact roots are explicit, existing, outside user/repository synchronized data, and on an unprotected fixed NTFS volume.

Dependencies are Windows PowerShell, Storage/Hyper-V cmdlets, CIM, the read-only CrashControl registry key, .NET path/file/crypto APIs and Windows `GetFileInformationByHandle`/`CreateDirectoryW`. Exceptions are fail-closed. Run-owned directories use atomic `CreateDirectoryW`, whose existing-target failure is surfaced; VHDX creation uses `New-MftVhdxCreateNew` with an injected create action so an AlreadyExists race can be tested without Hyper-V. The seam does not claim to have run or prove native Hyper-V behavior on a physical host. Exact static and mocked rejection/collision cases (volume root, repo/OneDrive/Documents, removable/non-NTFS, <60 GiB, existing contents, reparse, protected role, stale identity, directory collision, and VHDX collision) are in `Test-MftPhysicalSeedContracts.ps1`; no host storage mutation is used there.
